board_events.text: A single alkyl iodide from a C4H10O ether means the two alkyl groups must be identical.
So the ether is diethyl ether. Both ethyls are primary, cleavage is SN2, and excess hot HI takes both halves to ethyl iodide, one product.
Contrast the isomeric tert-butyl methyl ether under the same conditions.
Its tertiary centre forces an SN1 cleavage, giving two different products, tert-butyl iodide and iodomethane.
Same molecular formula, one product for the symmetric primary ether, two for the unsymmetric tertiary one: the product count itself is diagnostic.

segments.text: Our final worked example is a J E E Advanced deduction, and it runs the whole cleavage logic in reverse. You are told the products, and you must work back to the ether.
The clue is this. An ether of formula C four H ten O, cleaved with excess hot hydrogen iodide, gives just a single alkyl iodide. From that one fact, deduce the structure.
The board contrasts two isomeric ethers of that formula. On the left, the one that gives a single product. On the right, its isomer, which gives two. The difference is the answer.

Reason it out. If excess hot hydrogen iodide takes both halves of an ether all the way to alkyl iodide, and you get only one kind of iodide, then the two alkyl groups must have been identical to begin with.

For the formula C four H ten O, the ether with two identical alkyl groups is diethyl ether. Both ethyls are primary, the cleavage is a clean S N two, and excess hot hydrogen iodide carries both halves to ethyl iodide. One product, exactly as observed.
Now the instructive contrast, the isomeric tert butyl methyl ether under the very same conditions. Same molecular formula, completely different behaviour.
Its tertiary centre forces an S N one cleavage, so it gives two different products, tert butyl iodide and iodomethane. Two distinct iodides, not one.

<whisper>And here is the deep lesson.</whisper> Same molecular formula, yet one product for the symmetric primary ether and two for the unsymmetric tertiary one. The very count of products is diagnostic of the ether's structure. Counting the products is itself a deduction tool.
हमारा आख़िरी worked example एक J E E Advanced deduction है, और ये पूरी cleavage logic को उलटा चलाता है। आपको products बताए जाते हैं, और आपको ether तक पीछे जाना है।
clue ये है। formula C four H ten O वाला एक ether, excess hot hydrogen iodide से टूटकर, बस एक ही alkyl iodide देता है। उस एक fact से structure deduce कीजिए।
board उस formula के दो isomeric ethers को contrast करता है। बाईं ओर वो जो एक ही product देता है। दाईं ओर उसका isomer, जो दो देता है। यही फ़र्क़ जवाब है।
reason कीजिए। अगर excess hot hydrogen iodide एक ether के दोनों halves को पूरा alkyl iodide तक ले जाए, और आपको सिर्फ़ एक तरह का iodide मिले, तो दोनों alkyl groups शुरू से एक जैसे रहे होंगे।

formula C four H ten O के लिए, दो एक जैसे alkyl groups वाला ether है diethyl ether। दोनों ethyls primary हैं, cleavage एक clean S N two है, और excess hot hydrogen iodide दोनों halves को ethyl iodide तक ले जाता है। एक product, ठीक जैसा देखा गया।
अब शिक्षाप्रद contrast, उन्हीं conditions में isomeric tert butyl methyl ether। वही molecular formula, बिल्कुल अलग behaviour।
इसका tertiary centre एक S N one cleavage मजबूर करता है, तो ये दो अलग products देता है, tert butyl iodide और iodomethane। दो अलग iodides, एक नहीं।

<whisper>और ये रही गहरी सीख।</whisper> वही molecular formula, फिर भी symmetric primary ether के लिए एक product और unsymmetric tertiary के लिए दो। products की गिनती ही ether की structure बता देती है। products गिनना ख़ुद एक deduction tool है।

board_events.text: Traps in the ether subtopic
Trying to make di-tert-butyl ether (or any 3-degree-halide ether) by Williamson. A 3-degree halide only eliminates; keep the halide primary, load the bulk on the alkoxide.
Applying the lower-alkyl-group rule to a tertiary ether. That SN2 rule holds for 1 and 2 degree; a tertiary centre switches to SN1 and the iodide goes onto the tertiary carbon.
Writing an aryl halide as a cleavage product of an aryl ether. The aryl-oxygen bond never breaks; anisole gives phenol plus alkyl halide.
Claiming ethers boil high "because of the oxygen." Ethers cannot hydrogen-bond to each other, so they boil like alkanes; only their water-solubility resembles alcohols.
Forgetting the temperature switch in alcohol dehydration: lower temperature gives the ether (substitution), higher gives the alkene (elimination).
Pro-tip: for any ether-plus-HI question, run a three-question triage in order.

Is a group aromatic? Aryl ether gives phenol plus alkyl halide. Is a group tertiary? SN1, iodide on the tertiary carbon. Otherwise SN2, iodide on the smaller alkyl, and if HI is hot and in excess, push every alcohol on to its iodide.

segments.text: Let us close Part three by gathering the ether traps. This is a compact subtopic, so a handful of clean rules locks the marks.

Trap one, trying to make di tert butyl ether, or any ether that would need a tertiary halide, by Williamson. It cannot be done. A tertiary halide only eliminates. Always keep the halide primary and load the bulk onto the alkoxide.

Trap two, applying the lower alkyl group rule to a tertiary ether. That S N two rule, iodide on the smaller group, holds only for primary and secondary ethers. The moment a centre is tertiary, the mechanism switches to S N one and the iodide goes onto the tertiary carbon, the opposite way.

Trap three, writing an aryl halide as a cleavage product of an aryl ether. Never. The aryl oxygen bond does not break. Anisole gives phenol plus an alkyl halide, and the phenol is where the aryl oxygen ends up.

Trap four, claiming ethers boil high because of the oxygen. They do not. Ethers cannot hydrogen bond to each other, so they boil like alkanes. Only their water solubility resembles alcohols, and for a completely different reason, accepting a hydrogen bond from water.

Trap five, forgetting the temperature switch in alcohol dehydration. Lower temperature gives the ether by substitution, higher temperature gives the alkene by elimination. Same acid, same alcohol, the temperature alone chooses.
<whisper>And now the pro tip that answers almost every cleavage question.</whisper> For any ether plus hydrogen iodide problem, run a three question triage, in this exact order.

First, is either group aromatic? If so, the aryl ether gives phenol plus an alkyl halide, done. If not, second question, is either group tertiary? If so, it is S N one and the iodide lands on the tertiary carbon. Otherwise, it is S N two, the iodide lands on the smaller alkyl group, and if the hydrogen iodide is hot and in excess, push every alcohol on to its iodide. That triage closes Part three, and the ethers.
चलिए Part three को ether traps इकट्ठा करके बंद करते हैं। ये एक compact subtopic है, तो कुछ साफ़ rules marks पक्के कर देते हैं।

Trap एक, Williamson से di tert butyl ether बनाने की कोशिश, या कोई भी ether जिसे tertiary halide चाहिए। ये हो ही नहीं सकता। tertiary halide सिर्फ़ eliminate करता है। हमेशा halide primary रखिए और bulk alkoxide पर लादिए।

Trap दो, tertiary ether पर lower alkyl group rule लगाना। वो S N two rule, iodide छोटे group पर, सिर्फ़ primary और secondary ethers के लिए है। जैसे ही कोई centre tertiary हो, mechanism S N one पर switch होता है और iodide tertiary carbon पर जाता है, उलटी ओर।

Trap तीन, aryl ether के cleavage product के रूप में एक aryl halide लिखना। कभी नहीं। aryl oxygen bond नहीं टूटता। anisole phenol plus एक alkyl halide देता है, और phenol वहीं है जहाँ aryl oxygen जाता है।

Trap चार, ये कहना कि ethers oxygen की वजह से ऊँचे boil होते हैं। नहीं होते। ethers आपस में hydrogen bond नहीं बना सकते, तो वो alkanes जैसे boil होते हैं। सिर्फ़ इनकी water solubility alcohols जैसी है, और बिल्कुल अलग कारण से, water से एक hydrogen bond स्वीकार करके।

Trap पाँच, alcohol dehydration में temperature switch भूल जाना। कम temperature substitution से ether देता है, ज़्यादा temperature elimination से alkene। वही acid, वही alcohol, सिर्फ़ temperature चुनता है।
<whisper>और अब वो pro tip जो लगभग हर cleavage question का जवाब देती है।</whisper> किसी भी ether plus hydrogen iodide problem के लिए, ठीक इसी क्रम में तीन सवालों की triage चलाइए।

पहला, क्या कोई group aromatic है? अगर हाँ, तो aryl ether phenol plus एक alkyl halide देता है, ख़त्म। अगर नहीं, दूसरा सवाल, क्या कोई group tertiary है? अगर हाँ, तो ये S N one है और iodide tertiary carbon पर आता है। वरना, ये S N two है, iodide छोटे alkyl group पर आता है, और अगर hydrogen iodide hot और excess में हो, तो हर alcohol को उसके iodide तक धकेलिए। यही triage Part three बंद करती है, और ethers भी।

board_events.text: Two alcohols the world runs on

board_events.caption: Same family, opposite effect on the body

board_events.text: Of all the alcohols, two matter most to industry and daily life: methanol and ethanol.
They sit at the top of the homologous series and are made on a massive scale.
They could hardly be more different in their effect on the body: ethanol is the alcohol of beverages, while a small dose of methanol can blind or kill.
This subtopic is about how each is manufactured, what each is used for, and the special forms of ethanol that exam questions love.
It is pure recall, so a few clean facts, anchored to good hooks, lock the marks.

segments.text: We close the chapter with a short, high yield recall topic, the two alcohols the world actually runs on. There is no mechanism here, just clean facts, so let us get them exactly right.
The board sets up the contrast that organises everything. Methanol on the left, ethanol on the right, same family, but almost opposite in what they do to the human body.
Of all the alcohols in the world, two matter most to industry and to daily life, methanol and ethanol. Everything else in this subtopic hangs off these two.
They both sit right at the top of the homologous series, the smallest members, and both are manufactured on an absolutely massive industrial scale.

But here is the contrast that examiners return to again and again. They could hardly differ more in their effect on the body. Ethanol is the alcohol of beverages, drinkable in moderation. A small dose of methanol, by contrast, can blind you or kill you.

So this subtopic has three simple jobs. How each alcohol is manufactured, what each is used for, and the special forms of ethanol, rectified, absolute, denatured, and power alcohol, that exam questions love to test.

<whisper>And a word on strategy.</whisper> This is pure recall, no derivations to fall back on. So the trick is to anchor each fact to a clean one word hook, and a handful of those hooks will lock every mark in this section.
chapter को एक छोटे, high yield recall topic से बंद करते हैं, वो दो alcohols जिन पर दुनिया सचमुच चलती है। यहाँ कोई mechanism नहीं, बस साफ़ facts, तो इन्हें बिल्कुल सही कर लेते हैं।
board वो contrast set करता है जो सब कुछ व्यवस्थित करता है। बाईं ओर methanol, दाईं ओर ethanol, एक ही family, पर इंसानी शरीर पर लगभग उलटा असर।
दुनिया के सारे alcohols में से, दो industry और रोज़मर्रा ज़िंदगी के लिए सबसे अहम हैं, methanol और ethanol। इस subtopic में बाक़ी सब इन्हीं दो पर टिका है।
ये दोनों homologous series के बिल्कुल ऊपर बैठते हैं, सबसे छोटे members, और दोनों बेहद बड़े industrial scale पर बनाए जाते हैं।

पर ये रहा वो contrast जिस पर examiners बार बार लौटते हैं। शरीर पर असर में ये इससे ज़्यादा अलग हो ही नहीं सकते। ethanol beverages का alcohol है, संयम में पीने लायक। इसके उलट methanol की एक छोटी मात्रा आपको अंधा कर सकती है या मार सकती है।

तो इस subtopic के तीन सरल काम हैं। हर alcohol कैसे बनता है, हर एक किस काम आता है, और ethanol के special forms, rectified, absolute, denatured, और power alcohol, जिन्हें exam questions पूछना पसंद करते हैं।

<whisper>और strategy पर एक बात।</whisper> ये pure recall है, गिरने के लिए कोई derivation नहीं। तो trick है हर fact को एक साफ़ एक शब्द के hook से बाँधना, और ऐसे कुछ hooks इस section का हर mark पक्का कर देंगे।

board_events.text: Methanol, the wood spirit
Methanol is also called methyl alcohol or "wood spirit," the last name a relic of its original manufacture by destructive distillation of wood.

board_events.caption: The syngas route to methanol
board_events.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 660 230" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" font-family="system-ui, sans-serif"><rect x="0" y="0" width="660" height="230" fill="#fbfaf7"/><text x="330" y="24" text-anchor="middle" font-size="15" font-weight="700" fill="#1f2933">Methanol: names & modern preparation</text><text x="120" y="95" text-anchor="middle" font-size="14" fill="#1f2933">CO + 2 H2</text><text x="120" y="115" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10.5" fill="#5a6570">from water gas / syngas</text><defs><marker id="m19088" markerWidth="9" markerHeight="9" refX="7" refY="3" orient="auto"><path d="M0,0 L7,3 L0,6 Z" fill="#2b6cb0"/></marker></defs><line x1="190" y1="88" x2="360" y2="88" stroke="#2b6cb0" stroke-width="1.8" marker-end="url(#m19088)"/><text x="275" y="80" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10.5" fill="#2b6cb0">ZnO–Cr2O3</text><text x="275" y="103" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" fill="#5a6570">573–673 K, 200–300 atm</text><text x="470" y="95" text-anchor="middle" font-size="15" font-weight="700" fill="#2f855a">CH3OH</text><rect x="60" y="140" width="270" height="70" rx="8" fill="#eef2f7" stroke="#2b6cb0" stroke-width="1.2"/><text x="195" y="163" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#2b6cb0">also called</text><text x="195" y="184" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10.5" fill="#1f2933">methyl alcohol, “wood spirit”</text><text x="195" y="201" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" fill="#5a6570">(old: destructive distillation of wood)</text><rect x="350" y="140" width="270" height="70" rx="8" fill="#fff8ef" stroke="#c05621" stroke-width="1.2"/><text x="485" y="163" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#c05621">uses</text><text x="485" y="182" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" fill="#5a6570">solvent, antifreeze, fuel,</text><text x="485" y="199" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" fill="#5a6570">feedstock → formaldehyde</text></svg>

board_events.text: Modern manufacture is the catalytic hydrogenation of carbon monoxide from water gas, over a ZnO-Cr2O3 catalyst at 573-673 K and 200-300 atm.
Methanol is a colourless, volatile liquid, boiling around 337 K and completely miscible with water.
Uses: as a solvent for paints, varnishes and shellac; as an antifreeze; as a fuel and fuel additive; and as a feedstock for formaldehyde, and hence plastics.

segments.text: Take methanol first. Anchor it to one word, wood, and much of its identity follows from there.

Methanol goes by two other names you must recognise, methyl alcohol and wood spirit. That last name, wood spirit, is a relic. Methanol was originally made by the destructive distillation of wood, and the nickname stuck.
But the modern route has nothing to do with wood. The board shows the industrial process, a clean high pressure reaction over a metal oxide catalyst.
Here is the equation to memorise. Carbon monoxide plus two molecules of hydrogen gives methanol.

Industrially, that carbon monoxide comes from water gas, or syngas, and it is hydrogenated over a zinc oxide chromium oxide catalyst at five hundred seventy three to six hundred seventy three kelvin, under two hundred to three hundred atmospheres. The high pressure and moderate temperature give a clean, high yield process.
Physically, methanol is a colourless, volatile liquid. It boils around three hundred thirty seven kelvin, and it is completely miscible with water, as a small alcohol should be.

And its uses are worth listing, because they show up in one mark questions. Methanol is a solvent for paints, varnishes, and shellac. It serves as an antifreeze in radiators. It is a fuel and fuel additive. And it is a feedstock for making formaldehyde, and therefore for plastics.
पहले methanol लीजिए। इसे एक शब्द से बाँधिए, wood, और इसकी बहुत सी पहचान वहीं से निकल आती है।

methanol के दो और नाम हैं जो पहचानने ज़रूरी हैं, methyl alcohol और wood spirit। वो आख़िरी नाम, wood spirit, एक अवशेष है। methanol मूल रूप से लकड़ी के destructive distillation से बनता था, और वो उपनाम चिपक गया।
पर modern route का लकड़ी से कोई लेना देना नहीं। board industrial process दिखाता है, एक metal oxide catalyst पर एक clean high pressure reaction।
ये रहा याद करने लायक equation। carbon monoxide plus दो hydrogen molecules methanol देते हैं।

industrially, वो carbon monoxide water gas, या syngas से आता है, और इसे zinc oxide chromium oxide catalyst पर five hundred seventy three से six hundred seventy three kelvin पर, two hundred से three hundred atmospheres में hydrogenate किया जाता है। high pressure और moderate temperature एक clean, high yield process देते हैं।
physically, methanol एक colourless, volatile liquid है। ये लगभग three hundred thirty seven kelvin पर boil होता है, और water में पूरी तरह miscible है, जैसा एक छोटे alcohol को होना चाहिए।

और इसके uses list करने लायक हैं, क्योंकि ये one mark questions में आते हैं। methanol paints, varnishes, और shellac के लिए एक solvent है। ये radiators में antifreeze का काम करता है। ये एक fuel और fuel additive है। और ये formaldehyde बनाने के लिए एक feedstock है, और इसलिए plastics के लिए।

RETINA</text><text x="340" y="182" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#c53030">small dose → blindness  ·  larger dose → fatal</text></svg>

board_events.text: Inside the body, methanol is oxidised first to formaldehyde and then to formic acid.
Formic acid attacks the optic nerve and retina.
Even a small ingested quantity can cause blindness, and a larger dose is fatal.
This is exactly why ethanol meant for industry is denatured with methanol, to make it undrinkable.
Hook it to a chain: methanol, oxidised to formic acid, damages the optic nerve, causes blindness.

segments.text: Now the single most tested fact about methanol, its toxicity. This is the exam point, so let us trace exactly why a clear, colourless liquid can blind a person.
The board shows the pathway inside the body. Methanol does not harm you directly. It is what the body turns it into that does the damage.
Step by step. Inside the body, methanol is oxidised first to formaldehyde, and then that formaldehyde is oxidised further to formic acid. It is a two step metabolic oxidation.
And here is the target. That formic acid attacks the optic nerve and the retina, the very machinery of sight. That is why the harm shows up as vision loss specifically.
So even a small ingested quantity of methanol can cause permanent blindness, and a larger dose is simply fatal. This is not a mild poison.

And this toxicity explains something practical we will meet in a moment. Ethanol meant for industry is deliberately laced with methanol, precisely to make it undrinkable, because a person tempted to drink it would be poisoned.
<whisper>Anchor the whole thing as a chain.</whisper> Methanol, oxidised to formic acid, damages the optic nerve, causes blindness. Say that chain once and the toxicity question is yours.
अब methanol के बारे में सबसे ज़्यादा पूछा जाने वाला fact, इसकी toxicity। यही exam point है, तो ठीक ठीक trace करते हैं कि एक साफ़, colourless liquid किसी को अंधा कैसे कर सकता है।
board शरीर के भीतर की pathway दिखाता है। methanol आपको सीधे नुक़सान नहीं पहुँचाता। नुक़सान वो पहुँचाता है जो शरीर इसे बना देता है।
step by step। शरीर के भीतर, methanol पहले formaldehyde में oxidise होता है, और फिर वो formaldehyde आगे formic acid में oxidise होता है। ये एक दो step का metabolic oxidation है।
और ये रहा target। वो formic acid optic nerve और retina पर attack करता है, देखने की असली मशीनरी पर। इसीलिए नुक़सान ख़ासकर दृष्टि की हानि के रूप में सामने आता है।
तो methanol की एक छोटी सी ingested मात्रा भी स्थायी अंधापन दे सकती है, और एक बड़ी dose बस जानलेवा है। ये कोई हल्का ज़हर नहीं है।

और ये toxicity एक practical बात समझाती है जो हम अभी मिलेंगे। industry के लिए बना ethanol जानबूझकर methanol से मिलाया जाता है, ठीक इसलिए कि उसे पीने लायक न छोड़े, क्योंकि उसे पीने की सोचने वाला इंसान ज़हर खा बैठेगा।
<whisper>पूरी चीज़ को एक chain की तरह बाँधिए।</whisper> methanol, formic acid में oxidise होकर, optic nerve को नुक़सान, अंधापन। ये chain एक बार बोलिए और toxicity का सवाल आपका।

board_events.text: Ethanol, the grain alcohol
Ethanol is also called ethyl alcohol or "grain alcohol," and it is the alcohol of all alcoholic drinks.

board_events.caption: The two enzyme-catalysed steps

zymase makes the ethanol</text></svg>

board_events.text: Fermentation makes ethanol on a large scale from the sugars in molasses or in starchy grains; yeast supplies the enzymes.
Fermentation is anaerobic at about 303 K; if air is admitted, the ethanol is instead oxidised to ethanoic acid, vinegar.

segments.text: Now ethanol, and its anchor word is grain. It is also called ethyl alcohol or grain alcohol, and it is the alcohol in every alcoholic drink.
Keep those names ready. Ethyl alcohol and grain alcohol are the same thing as ethanol, and a question may use any of the three names.
The classic route is fermentation, and the board shows it as two enzyme steps. Watch which enzyme does which job, because that is the whole exam point here.
Fermentation makes ethanol on a large scale from the sugars in molasses, that is cane sugar, or in starchy grains. The living workhorse is yeast, which supplies the two enzymes that do the chemistry.
Step one uses the enzyme invertase. Invertase hydrolyses sucrose, adding water to split it into its two hexose sugars, glucose and fructose.
Step two uses the enzyme zymase. Zymase then converts each hexose sugar into two molecules of ethanol and two molecules of carbon dioxide. That carbon dioxide is the fizzing you see in fermentation.

<whisper>And note the two conditions that are easy marks.</whisper> Fermentation is carried out anaerobically, in the near absence of air, at about three hundred three kelvin. Let air in, and the ethanol is instead oxidised onward to ethanoic acid, which is vinegar. So keep the air out.
अब ethanol, और इसका anchor शब्द है grain। इसे ethyl alcohol या grain alcohol भी कहते हैं, और ये हर alcoholic drink का alcohol है।
वो नाम तैयार रखिए। ethyl alcohol और grain alcohol ethanol की ही चीज़ हैं, और question तीनों में से कोई भी नाम इस्तेमाल कर सकता है।
classic route है fermentation, और board इसे दो enzyme steps के रूप में दिखाता है। देखिए कौन सा enzyme कौन सा काम करता है, क्योंकि यहाँ यही पूरा exam point है।
fermentation बड़े पैमाने पर molasses के sugars से, यानी cane sugar से, या starchy grains से ethanol बनाता है। जीवित workhorse है yeast, जो chemistry करने वाले दो enzymes देता है।
Step one enzyme invertase इस्तेमाल करता है। invertase sucrose को hydrolyse करता है, water जोड़कर इसे इसके दो hexose sugars, glucose और fructose में तोड़ता है।

Step two enzyme zymase इस्तेमाल करता है। zymase फिर हर hexose sugar को दो ethanol molecules और दो carbon dioxide molecules में बदल देता है। वो carbon dioxide ही fermentation में दिखने वाली bubbling है।

<whisper>और दो conditions ध्यान दीजिए जो आसान marks हैं।</whisper> fermentation anaerobically किया जाता है, हवा की लगभग अनुपस्थिति में, लगभग three hundred three kelvin पर। हवा आने दीजिए, और ethanol इसके बजाय आगे ethanoic acid में oxidise हो जाता है, जो vinegar है। तो हवा बाहर रखिए।

board_events.text: Ethanol is also made by the acid-catalysed hydration of ethene, the Markovnikov addition of water across the double bond, the dominant petrochemical route.
Physically it is a colourless liquid boiling around 351 K, miscible with water in all proportions; it boils higher than its isomeric ether because of hydrogen bonding.

Uses: in beverages; as a solvent in pharmacy, perfumery and industry; as an antiseptic, with about 70 percent ethanol most effective for skin; as a fuel; and as a starting material for many organic chemicals.
Ethanol is a central-nervous-system depressant; in moderate amounts it causes intoxication, and in excess it is dangerous.
Unlike methanol, ordinary ethanol is not acutely poisoning in small quantities, but ethanol contaminated with methanol, illicit liquor, is deadly.

segments.text: Fermentation is the classic route, but ethanol is also made industrially, and it has a long list of uses worth knowing. Let us finish the ethanol picture.
The board shows the industrial route on top and the uses and physiology below. Read the reaction first.

The dominant modern route is petrochemical. Ethanol is made by the acid catalysed hydration of ethene, which is simply the Markovnikov addition of water across the double bond, the very reaction we studied back in Part one.

Physically, ethanol is a colourless liquid that boils around three hundred fifty one kelvin, miscible with water in all proportions. And recall from earlier, it boils noticeably higher than its isomeric ether, purely because of hydrogen bonding.

Its uses span everyday life. In beverages, obviously. As a solvent in pharmacy, perfumery, and industry. As an antiseptic, where about seventy percent ethanol is most effective for disinfecting skin. As a fuel, blended into petrol. And as a starting material for a huge range of organic chemicals.

Physiologically, ethanol is a central nervous system depressant. In moderate amounts it produces the familiar intoxication, and in excess it impairs judgement and coordination and becomes genuinely dangerous.

<whisper>But here is the crucial contrast with methanol.</whisper> Unlike methanol, ordinary ethanol is not acutely poisoning in small quantities. The danger is when ethanol is contaminated with methanol, as in illicit liquor, which is exactly what makes such liquor deadly.
fermentation classic route है, पर ethanol industrially भी बनता है, और इसके uses की एक लंबी list जानने लायक है। चलिए ethanol की तस्वीर पूरी करते हैं।
board ऊपर industrial route और नीचे uses तथा physiology दिखाता है। पहले reaction पढ़िए।
dominant modern route petrochemical है। ethanol ethene के acid catalysed hydration से बनता है, जो बस double bond पर water का Markovnikov addition है, वही reaction जो हमने Part one में पढ़ी थी।

physically, ethanol एक colourless liquid है जो लगभग three hundred fifty one kelvin पर boil होता है, water में हर अनुपात में miscible। और पहले वाला याद कीजिए, ये अपने isomeric ether से साफ़ ऊँचा boil होता है, सिर्फ़ hydrogen bonding की वजह से।

इसके uses रोज़मर्रा ज़िंदगी में फैले हैं। beverages में, ज़ाहिर है। pharmacy, perfumery, और industry में solvent के रूप में। antiseptic के रूप में, जहाँ त्वचा को disinfect करने के लिए करीब seventy percent ethanol सबसे असरदार है। fuel के रूप में, petrol में मिलाकर। और कई organic chemicals के लिए starting material के रूप में।

physiologically, ethanol एक central nervous system depressant है। moderate मात्रा में ये जानी पहचानी intoxication देता है, और ज़्यादा में ये judgement और coordination बिगाड़ता है और सचमुच ख़तरनाक हो जाता है।

<whisper>पर ये रहा methanol से अहम contrast।</whisper> methanol के उलट, साधारण ethanol छोटी मात्रा में acutely poisoning नहीं है। ख़तरा तब है जब ethanol methanol से दूषित हो, जैसे illicit liquor में, और ठीक यही ऐसी शराब को जानलेवा बनाता है।

sections.title: Grades of ethanol I: rectified and absolute

board_events.text: Rectified spirit and absolute alcohol

board_events.caption: The azeotrope and how to beat it
board_events.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 660 220" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" font-family="system-ui, sans-serif"><rect x="0" y="0" width="660" height="220" fill="#fbfaf7"/><text x="330" y="24" text-anchor="middle" font-size="15" font-weight="700" fill="#1f2933">Rectified spirit & absolute alcohol</text><rect x="40" y="45" width="290" height="150" rx="10" fill="#eef2f7" stroke="#2b6cb0" stroke-width="1.4"/><text x="185" y="72" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#2b6cb0">Rectified spirit</text><text x="185" y="98" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" fill="#1f2933">95.5% ethanol + 4.5% water</text><text x="185" y="122" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10.5" fill="#5a6570">fractional distillation of</text><text x="185" y="138" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10.5" fill="#5a6570">fermented liquor</text><text x="185" y="168" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#c53030">azeotrope: cannot pass 95.5%</text><rect x="350" y="45" width="290" height="150" rx="10" fill="#f0fff4" stroke="#2f855a" stroke-width="1.4"/><text x="495" y="72" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#2f855a">Absolute alcohol</text><text x="495" y="98" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" fill="#1f2933">~100% ethanol</text><text x="495" y="122" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10.5" fill="#5a6570">remove residual water by</text><text x="495" y="142" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10.5" fill="#5a6570">quicklime (CaO), or benzene</text><text x="495" y="162" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10.5" fill="#5a6570">azeotropic distillation</text></svg>

board_events.text: Rectified spirit is the roughly 95.5 percent ethanol, 4.5 percent water mixture obtained by fractional distillation of fermented liquor.
It cannot be concentrated further by ordinary distillation, because it forms a constant-boiling azeotropic mixture with water.
Absolute alcohol is essentially 100 percent ethanol, made by removing the residual water from rectified spirit.
That water is removed by treatment with quicklime, calcium oxide, or by azeotropic distillation with benzene.
Hook it: 95.5 percent is rectified, 100 percent is absolute, and the azeotrope is the wall between them.

segments.text: Now the four special forms of ethanol, which are frequently confused and frequently tested. Take the first two together, rectified spirit and absolute alcohol, because they are two points on one story.
The board pairs them. Rectified spirit on the left at about ninety five and a half percent, absolute alcohol on the right at essentially one hundred percent. The wall between them is the azeotrope.

Start with rectified spirit. It is the roughly ninety five point five percent ethanol, four point five percent water mixture that you obtain by fractional distillation of fermented liquor. That is as far as plain distillation gets you.

And here is the key limitation. Rectified spirit cannot be concentrated any further by ordinary distillation, because ethanol and water form a constant boiling, azeotropic mixture at that composition. The vapour has the same composition as the liquid, so distillation stops making progress.
Absolute alcohol is the next step up, essentially one hundred percent ethanol. You make it by removing that last stubborn four and a half percent of water from rectified spirit.

And you remove it not by distilling harder, but chemically or azeotropically. Either treat the spirit with quicklime, that is calcium oxide, which soaks up the water, or perform an azeotropic distillation with benzene.

<whisper>Anchor the pair with two numbers.</whisper> Ninety five and a half percent is rectified, one hundred percent is absolute, and the azeotrope is the wall that ordinary distillation cannot climb over. Those three ideas answer every rectified versus absolute question.
अब ethanol के चार special forms, जो अक्सर confuse होते हैं और अक्सर पूछे जाते हैं। पहले दो साथ लीजिए, rectified spirit और absolute alcohol, क्योंकि ये एक ही कहानी के दो points हैं।
board इन्हें जोड़ता है। बाईं ओर rectified spirit करीब पंचानबे दशमलव पाँच percent पर, दाईं ओर absolute alcohol लगभग सौ percent पर। इनके बीच की दीवार azeotrope है।

rectified spirit से शुरू। ये करीब ninety five point five percent ethanol, four point five percent water का mixture है जो आपको fermented liquor के fractional distillation से मिलता है। सादा distillation आपको बस इतना ही ले जाता है।

और ये रही key limitation। rectified spirit को ordinary distillation से आगे concentrate नहीं किया जा सकता, क्योंकि ethanol और water उस composition पर एक constant boiling, azeotropic mixture बनाते हैं। vapour की composition liquid जैसी ही होती है, तो distillation आगे बढ़ना बंद कर देता है।
absolute alcohol अगला step है, लगभग सौ percent ethanol। इसे आप rectified spirit से वो आख़िरी ज़िद्दी साढ़े चार percent water हटाकर बनाते हैं।

और आप इसे ज़्यादा distill करके नहीं, बल्कि chemically या azeotropically हटाते हैं। या तो spirit को quicklime, यानी calcium oxide, से treat कीजिए, जो water सोख लेता है, या benzene के साथ एक azeotropic distillation कीजिए।

<whisper>इस जोड़ी को दो numbers से बाँधिए।</whisper> ninety five point five percent rectified है, सौ percent absolute है, और azeotrope वो दीवार है जिसे ordinary distillation पार नहीं कर सकता। यही तीन ideas हर rectified बनाम absolute सवाल का जवाब देते हैं।

sections.title: Grades of ethanol II: denatured and power alcohol

board_events.text: Denatured alcohol and power alcohol

board_events.caption: Two more forms of ethanol
board_events.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 660 220" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" font-family="system-ui, sans-serif"><rect x="0" y="0" width="660" height="220" fill="#fbfaf7"/><text x="330" y="24" text-anchor="middle" font-size="15" font-weight="700" fill="#1f2933">Denatured alcohol & power alcohol</text><rect x="40" y="45" width="290" height="150" rx="10" fill="#fff4f2" stroke="#c53030" stroke-width="1.4"/><text x="185" y="72" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#c53030">Denatured (methylated spirit)</text><text x="185" y="98" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#1f2933">ethanol + methanol</text><text x="185" y="118" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#1f2933">+ pyridine + dye</text><text x="185" y="146" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10.5" fill="#5a6570">made undrinkable</text><text x="185" y="164" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10.5" fill="#5a6570">tax-free for industry</text><rect x="350" y="45" width="290" height="150" rx="10" fill="#f0fff4" stroke="#2f855a" stroke-width="1.4"/><text x="495" y="72" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#2f855a">Power alcohol (gasohol)</text><text x="495" y="98" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#1f2933">ethanol blended with petrol</text><text x="495" y="122" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10.5" fill="#5a6570">used as a motor fuel</text><text x="495" y="148" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10.5" fill="#5a6570">stretches fuel supply,</text><text x="495" y="166" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10.5" fill="#5a6570">raises octane rating</text></svg>

board_events.text: Denatured alcohol, or methylated spirit, is ethanol made unfit for drinking by adding poisonous or foul substances such as methanol, with pyridine and a dye to mark it.
It is denatured so industrial ethanol can be sold cheaply, without the heavy excise duty on drinkable alcohol, while deterring misuse as a beverage.
Power alcohol is ethanol blended with petrol, typically with a small percentage of benzene as co-solvent, and used as a motor fuel.
Modern petrol-ethanol blends, gasohol, are the same idea: ethanol stretches the fuel supply and raises the octane rating.
Hook the four forms: poison-added is denatured; petrol-blend is power; 95.5 is rectified; 100 is absolute.

segments.text: Now the other two forms of ethanol, denatured alcohol and power alcohol. Both are ethanol dressed up for a specific job.
The board pairs them. On the left, denatured alcohol, ethanol deliberately spoiled. On the right, power alcohol, ethanol turned into fuel.

Denatured alcohol, also called methylated spirit, is ethanol made unfit for drinking. It is done by adding poisonous or foul substances such as methanol, along with pyridine and a dye, often a blue or purple colour, to mark it clearly.

And the reason is economic. Ethanol is denatured so that industrial ethanol can be sold cheaply, without the heavy excise duty that is levied on drinkable alcohol, while at the same time deterring anyone from misusing it as a beverage. The methanol makes sure of that.
Power alcohol is completely different. It is ethanol blended with petrol, typically with a small percentage of benzene as a co solvent, and used as a motor fuel in engines.

And this is not just history. Modern petrol ethanol blends, the gasohol you may have heard of, are exactly the same idea. The ethanol stretches the fuel supply and raises the octane rating of the fuel.

<whisper>Now lock all four forms with one hook each.</whisper> Poison added is denatured. Petrol blend is power alcohol. Ninety five and a half percent is rectified. And one hundred percent is absolute. Four forms, four hooks, and the whole confusing cluster is yours.
अब ethanol के दूसरे दो forms, denatured alcohol और power alcohol। दोनों एक ख़ास काम के लिए सजाया गया ethanol हैं।
board इन्हें जोड़ता है। बाईं ओर denatured alcohol, जानबूझकर ख़राब किया ethanol। दाईं ओर power alcohol, fuel में बदला ethanol।

denatured alcohol, जिसे methylated spirit भी कहते हैं, पीने के अयोग्य बनाया ethanol है। ये methanol जैसे ज़हरीले या बदबूदार पदार्थ मिलाकर किया जाता है, साथ में pyridine और एक dye, अक्सर नीला या बैंगनी रंग, इसे साफ़ पहचानने के लिए।

और कारण आर्थिक है। ethanol denatured किया जाता है ताकि industrial ethanol सस्ता बेचा जा सके, उस भारी excise duty के बिना जो drinkable alcohol पर लगती है, और साथ ही किसी को इसे beverage के रूप में दुरुपयोग करने से रोका जा सके। methanol ये पक्का कर देता है।
power alcohol बिल्कुल अलग है। ये petrol में मिलाया ethanol है, आम तौर पर co solvent के रूप में benzene के एक छोटे percentage के साथ, और engines में motor fuel के रूप में इस्तेमाल होता है।
और ये सिर्फ़ इतिहास नहीं है। modern petrol ethanol blends, वो gasohol जिसके बारे में आपने सुना होगा, ठीक वही idea हैं। ethanol fuel supply को बढ़ाता है और fuel की octane rating बढ़ाता है।

<whisper>अब चारों forms को एक एक hook से पक्का कीजिए।</whisper> poison मिलाया तो denatured। petrol blend तो power alcohol। ninety five point five percent तो rectified। और सौ percent तो absolute। चार forms, चार hooks, और पूरा उलझाने वाला cluster आपका।

sections.title: Worked example: the two fermentation steps

board_events.text: CBSE: write the two enzyme-catalysed steps

board_events.caption: Invertase then zymase
board_events.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 660 210" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" font-family="system-ui, sans-serif"><rect x="0" y="0" width="660" height="210" fill="#fbfaf7"/><text x="330" y="26" text-anchor="middle" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#1f2933">Fermentation of cane sugar: name each enzyme</text><text x="90" y="90" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" fill="#1f2933">C12H22O11</text><defs><marker id="m14583" markerWidth="9" markerHeight="9" refX="7" refY="3" orient="auto"><path d="M0,0 L7,3 L0,6 Z" fill="#2b6cb0"/></marker></defs><line x1="145" y1="83" x2="265" y2="83" stroke="#2b6cb0" stroke-width="1.8" marker-end="url(#m14583)"/><text x="205" y="75" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10.5" fill="#2b6cb0">invertase</text><text x="205" y="98" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" fill="#5a6570">+ H2O</text><text x="355" y="90" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" fill="#1f2933">glucose + fructose</text><defs><marker id="m365110" markerWidth="9" markerHeight="9" refX="7" refY="3" orient="auto"><path d="M0,0 L7,3 L0,6 Z" fill="#2b6cb0"/></marker></defs><line x1="365" y1="110" x2="365" y2="145" stroke="#2b6cb0" stroke-width="1.8" marker-end="url(#m365110)"/><text x="365" y="102" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10.5" fill="#2b6cb0">zymase</text><text x="365" y="172" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#2f855a">2 C2H5OH + 2 CO2</text><text x="540" y="88" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10.5" fill="#5a6570">Step 1: split sucrose</text><text x="540" y="150" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10.5" fill="#5a6570">Step 2: make ethanol</text><text x="330" y="200" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10.5" fill="#5a6570">anaerobic, ~303 K</text></svg>

board_events.text: Step 1, invertase: sucrose plus water gives glucose plus fructose.
Step 2, zymase: the hexose sugar gives two ethanol plus two carbon dioxide.
State the conditions too: fermentation is anaerobic, at about 303 K.

segments.text: A quick C B S E board question that is almost pure recall. Write the two enzyme catalysed steps in the fermentation of cane sugar to ethanol, and name the enzyme in each.
The board lays out the two steps. Notice the enzyme sitting on each arrow, because naming them is where the marks are.
Step one uses invertase. Invertase hydrolyses sucrose, so sucrose plus water gives its two hexose sugars, glucose and fructose.
Write that first equation cleanly. Sucrose plus water gives glucose plus fructose, catalysed by invertase.
Step two uses zymase. Zymase then converts the hexose sugar into two molecules of ethanol and two molecules of carbon dioxide.
And the second equation. Glucose gives two ethanol plus two carbon dioxide, catalysed by zymase.

<whisper>And do not drop the easy conditions mark.</whisper> State clearly that fermentation is carried out anaerobically, at about three hundred three kelvin. Two equations, two enzyme names, and the conditions, and the answer is complete.
एक quick C B S E board question जो लगभग pure recall है। cane sugar से ethanol के fermentation के दो enzyme catalysed steps लिखिए, और हर एक में enzyme नाम बताइए।
board दोनों steps रखता है। हर arrow पर बैठा enzyme देखिए, क्योंकि इन्हें नाम देना ही marks है।
Step one invertase इस्तेमाल करता है। invertase sucrose को hydrolyse करता है, तो sucrose plus water इसके दो hexose sugars, glucose और fructose देता है।
वो पहला equation साफ़ लिखिए। sucrose plus water glucose plus fructose देता है, invertase से catalysed।
Step two zymase इस्तेमाल करता है। zymase फिर hexose sugar को दो ethanol molecules और दो carbon dioxide molecules में बदल देता है।
और दूसरा equation। glucose दो ethanol plus दो carbon dioxide देता है, zymase से catalysed।

<whisper>और conditions का आसान mark मत छोड़िए।</whisper> साफ़ बताइए कि fermentation anaerobically किया जाता है, लगभग three hundred three kelvin पर। दो equations, दो enzyme नाम, और conditions, और जवाब पूरा।

sections.title: Worked example: sorting the recall facts

board_events.text: NEET speed trap: which statement is correct?
Statements: (i) wood spirit is ethanol; (ii) methanol causes blindness; (iii) absolute alcohol is 95.5 percent ethanol.

board_events.caption: Three statements, one true
board_events.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 660 220" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" font-family="system-ui, sans-serif"><rect x="0" y="0" width="660" height="220" fill="#fbfaf7"/><text x="330" y="26" text-anchor="middle" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#1f2933">Which statement is correct?</text><rect x="40" y="50" width="590" height="45" fill="#fff4f2" stroke="#d0cabb" stroke-width="1"/><text x="60" y="78" text-anchor="start" font-size="11.5" fill="#1f2933">(i) wood spirit is ethanol</text><text x="600" y="78" text-anchor="end" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#c53030">FALSE</text><text x="60" y="92" text-anchor="start" font-size="9.5" fill="#5a6570">wood spirit = methanol</text><rect x="40" y="105" width="590" height="45" fill="#f0fff4" stroke="#d0cabb" stroke-width="1"/><text x="60" y="133" text-anchor="start" font-size="11.5" fill="#1f2933">(ii) methanol causes blindness</text><text x="600" y="133" text-anchor="end" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#2f855a">TRUE</text><text x="60" y="147" text-anchor="start" font-size="9.5" fill="#5a6570">oxidised to formic acid, hits optic nerve</text><rect x="40" y="160" width="590" height="45" fill="#fff4f2" stroke="#d0cabb" stroke-width="1"/><text x="60" y="188" text-anchor="start" font-size="11.5" fill="#1f2933">(iii) absolute alcohol is 95.5% ethanol</text><text x="600" y="188" text-anchor="end" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#c53030">FALSE</text><text x="60" y="202" text-anchor="start" font-size="9.5" fill="#5a6570">95.5% = rectified; absolute is ~100%</text></svg>

board_events.text: Only (ii) is correct.
Statement (i) is false: wood spirit is methanol, not ethanol.
Statement (iii) is false: 95.5 percent ethanol is rectified spirit; absolute alcohol is about 100 percent.
Statement (ii) is true: methanol's oxidation to formic acid damages the optic nerve, causing blindness.

segments.text: This N E E T speed trap simply checks whether your recall hooks are crisp. Three statements are given, and exactly one is correct. Let us test them against our hooks.
The three statements are these. One, wood spirit is ethanol. Two, methanol causes blindness. Three, absolute alcohol is ninety five and a half percent ethanol.
The board grades each one. Two are false, one is true. Run your hooks and you will see immediately which is which.
The answer is that only statement two is correct. Now let us justify each verdict, because a good answer explains the falsehoods, not just picks the right option.
Statement one is false. Recall the hook, wood means methanol. Wood spirit is methanol, not ethanol. So calling wood spirit ethanol is simply wrong.

Statement three is false too. Recall the numbers. Ninety five and a half percent ethanol is rectified spirit, not absolute alcohol. Absolute alcohol is about one hundred percent. The statement has swapped the two grades.

<whisper>And statement two is the true one.</whisper> Methanol's oxidation inside the body to formic acid damages the optic nerve, which causes blindness. That toxicity chain is genuine, so statement two stands. Only two is correct.
ये N E E T speed trap बस जाँचता है कि आपके recall hooks crisp हैं या नहीं। तीन statements दिए हैं, और ठीक एक सही है। इन्हें अपने hooks पर test करते हैं।
तीन statements ये हैं। एक, wood spirit ethanol है। दो, methanol अंधापन देता है। तीन, absolute alcohol पंचानबे दशमलव पाँच percent ethanol है।
board हर एक को grade करता है। दो false हैं, एक true। अपने hooks चलाइए और तुरंत दिख जाएगा कौन कौन है।
जवाब ये है कि सिर्फ़ statement दो सही है। अब हर verdict justify करते हैं, क्योंकि एक अच्छा जवाब झूठ को समझाता है, सिर्फ़ सही option नहीं चुनता।
statement एक false है। hook याद कीजिए, wood मतलब methanol। wood spirit methanol है, ethanol नहीं। तो wood spirit को ethanol कहना बस ग़लत है।

statement तीन भी false है। numbers याद कीजिए। ninety five point five percent ethanol rectified spirit है, absolute alcohol नहीं। absolute alcohol लगभग सौ percent है। statement ने दोनों grades आपस में बदल दिए हैं।

<whisper>और statement दो सही वाला है।</whisper> शरीर के भीतर methanol का formic acid में oxidation optic nerve को नुक़सान पहुँचाता है, जो अंधापन देता है। वो toxicity chain असली है, तो statement दो टिकता है। सिर्फ़ दो सही है।

board_events.text: JEE Main: why not fractional distillation, and how instead?
Why can rectified spirit not be converted to absolute alcohol by simple fractional distillation, and how is the conversion actually achieved?

board_events.caption: The azeotrope blocks distillation

board_events.text: Ethanol and water form a constant-boiling azeotrope at about 95.5 percent ethanol.
At the azeotrope the vapour has the same composition as the liquid, so distillation cannot enrich the mixture past that point.
So the water is removed chemically or azeotropically instead.
Reflux over quicklime, calcium oxide, and distil; or use azeotropic distillation with benzene, to give absolute, about 100 percent, alcohol.

segments.text: Our last worked example is a short J E E Main reasoning question, and it is really the azeotrope idea in disguise. Why can rectified spirit not be pushed up to absolute alcohol by simple fractional distillation, and how is it actually done?
So there are two parts. First, explain the obstacle. Second, give the real method that gets around it.
The board pictures the obstacle. Distillation runs up against a wall at about ninety five and a half percent and cannot climb past it.
Here is the obstacle stated precisely. Ethanol and water form a constant boiling azeotrope at about ninety five and a half percent ethanol. That composition is a trap for ordinary distillation.

And here is why the azeotrope traps you. At that composition, the vapour rising off the boiling liquid has exactly the same composition as the liquid itself. So condensing that vapour gives you the same mixture back, and distillation simply cannot enrich beyond that point.
So the fix is not to distil harder, but to attack the water directly, either chemically or azeotropically.

<whisper>Name a method to secure the mark.</whisper> Either reflux the spirit over quicklime, that is calcium oxide, which chemically soaks up the water, and then distil. Or perform an azeotropic distillation with benzene. Either route delivers absolute alcohol, about one hundred percent. That closes the worked examples.

हमारा आख़िरी worked example एक छोटा J E E Main reasoning question है, और ये असल में भेस बदले azeotrope का idea है। rectified spirit को simple fractional distillation से absolute alcohol तक क्यों नहीं धकेला जा सकता, और ये असल में कैसे किया जाता है?
तो दो हिस्से हैं। पहला, रुकावट समझाइए। दूसरा, वो असली method दीजिए जो इसे पार करता है।
board रुकावट की तस्वीर दिखाता है। distillation करीब पंचानबे दशमलव पाँच percent पर एक दीवार से टकराता है और उससे आगे नहीं चढ़ सकता।
ये रही रुकावट ठीक ठीक बताई गई। ethanol और water लगभग ninety five point five percent ethanol पर एक constant boiling azeotrope बनाते हैं। वो composition ordinary distillation के लिए एक जाल है।

और azeotrope आपको क्यों फँसाता है। उस composition पर, boiling liquid से उठती vapour की composition liquid जैसी ही होती है। तो उस vapour को condense करने पर वही mixture वापस मिलता है, और distillation उस point से आगे enrich कर ही नहीं सकता।
तो हल distill ज़्यादा करना नहीं, बल्कि water पर सीधे attack करना है, या तो chemically या azeotropically।

<whisper>mark पक्का करने के लिए एक method नाम लीजिए।</whisper> या तो spirit को quicklime, यानी calcium oxide, पर reflux कीजिए, जो chemically water सोख लेता है, और फिर distil कीजिए। या benzene के साथ एक azeotropic distillation कीजिए। दोनों route absolute alcohol देते हैं, लगभग सौ percent। इसी के साथ worked examples पूरे।

board_events.text: Recall traps and hooks
Calling "wood spirit" ethanol. Wood spirit is methanol, from destructive distillation of wood.
Confusing rectified spirit with absolute alcohol. Rectified is the 95.5 percent azeotrope; absolute is about 100 percent.
Thinking absolute alcohol is reachable by ordinary distillation. The ethanol-water azeotrope blocks it; you need quicklime or benzene azeotropic distillation.
Mixing up the two fermentation enzymes. Invertase splits sucrose; zymase makes ethanol.
Pro-tip: anchor each fact to a one-word hook. Wood means methanol; grain means ethanol; 95.5 means rectified; 100 means absolute; poison-added means denatured; petrol-blend means power.
For toxicity, remember the chain: methanol is oxidised to formic acid, which damages the optic nerve, causing blindness.

segments.text: Let us close the subtopic by gathering its recall traps. Since this section is pure memory, the traps are all about mixing up look alike facts.
Trap one, calling wood spirit ethanol. It is not. Wood spirit is methanol, named for its old manufacture by the destructive distillation of wood. Wood always points to methanol.

Trap two, confusing rectified spirit with absolute alcohol. Rectified spirit is the ninety five and a half percent azeotrope. Absolute alcohol is about one hundred percent. Keep the two numbers apart.

Trap three, thinking you can reach absolute alcohol by ordinary distillation. You cannot, because the ethanol water azeotrope blocks the way. You need quicklime, or an azeotropic distillation with benzene, to strip out that last water.
Trap four, mixing up the two fermentation enzymes. Keep their jobs distinct. Invertase splits sucrose into its sugars. Zymase makes the ethanol. Two enzymes, two clearly different roles.

<whisper>And now the pro tip that carries the whole subtopic.</whisper> Anchor every fact to a single word hook. Wood means methanol. Grain means ethanol. Ninety five point five means rectified. One hundred means absolute. Poison added means denatured. Petrol blend means power alcohol. Six hooks, and the whole cluster is locked.

And for the toxicity question specifically, hold the chain in order. Methanol is oxidised to formic acid, formic acid damages the optic nerve, and the result is blindness. That closes the commercial alcohols.
चलिए subtopic को इसके recall traps इकट्ठा करके बंद करते हैं। चूँकि ये section pure memory है, traps सब मिलती जुलती facts को उलझाने के बारे में हैं।
Trap एक, wood spirit को ethanol कहना। ये नहीं है। wood spirit methanol है, इसके पुराने निर्माण के नाम पर जो लकड़ी के destructive distillation से होता था। wood हमेशा methanol की ओर इशारा करता है।
Trap दो, rectified spirit को absolute alcohol से उलझाना। rectified spirit ninety five point five percent azeotrope है। absolute alcohol लगभग सौ percent है। दोनों numbers अलग रखिए।

Trap तीन, ये सोचना कि आप ordinary distillation से absolute alcohol तक पहुँच सकते हैं। नहीं पहुँच सकते, क्योंकि ethanol water azeotrope रास्ता रोक देता है। उस आख़िरी water को निकालने के लिए quicklime, या benzene के साथ एक azeotropic distillation चाहिए।
Trap चार, दोनों fermentation enzymes उलझाना। इनके काम अलग रखिए। invertase sucrose को उसके sugars में तोड़ता है। zymase ethanol बनाता है। दो enzymes, दो साफ़ अलग roles।

<whisper>और अब वो pro tip जो पूरे subtopic को संभालती है।</whisper> हर fact को एक शब्द के hook से बाँधिए। wood मतलब methanol। grain मतलब ethanol। ninety five point five मतलब rectified। सौ मतलब absolute। poison मिलाया मतलब denatured। petrol blend मतलब power alcohol। छह hooks, और पूरा cluster lock।

और ख़ासकर toxicity सवाल के लिए, chain को क्रम में रखिए। methanol formic acid में oxidise होता है, formic acid optic nerve को नुक़सान पहुँचाता है, और नतीजा अंधापन है। इसी के साथ commercial alcohols पूरे।

board_events.text: Your complete toolkit for the chapter
Geometry: alcohol C-O-H angle just under $109^\circ 28'$; phenol C-O about 136 pm (shorter); ether C-O-C about $111.7^\circ$, C-O about 141 pm.
Acidity, strongest first: carboxylic acid, carbonic acid, phenol, water, alcohol. Anchors: acids about 4-5, phenol about 10, water about 15.7, ethanol about 16.
Alkene hydration: acid gives Markovnikov, may rearrange; oxymercuration gives Markovnikov, no rearrangement; HBO gives anti-Markovnikov, syn, no rearrangement.
Phenol by signature: 623 K high pressure is Dow; alkali fusion of benzenesulphonic acid; 273-278 K diazotisation; cumene gives phenol plus acetone.

Alcohol C-O orders (all track carbocation stability): Lucas SN1 and dehydration E1 both $3^\circ \gt 2^\circ \gt 1^\circ$; oxidation 1-degree to aldehyde to acid, 2-degree to ketone, 3-degree resists; iodoform needs the CH3CH(OH) unit.
Ether cleavage by HX (HI, then HBr, then HCl): aryl ether gives phenol plus alkyl halide; a tertiary group goes SN1 with iodide on the tertiary carbon; otherwise SN2 with iodide on the smaller alkyl.
Commercial: fermentation is invertase then zymase; rectified is 95.5 percent, absolute is about 100 percent, denatured is ethanol plus methanol, power alcohol is the petrol blend.

segments.text: We have reached the end of the chapter, so this is the formula recap. The rule here is simple. I am going to restate the whole toolkit, not re teach it. Run your eye over each item and check that it is already solid in your mind.
First, the one general formula. A saturated compound with a single oxygen fits C n H two n plus two O, and this is why a monohydric alcohol and its isomeric ether are functional isomers.

Next, the geometry numbers. The alcohol carbon oxygen hydrogen angle is just under one hundred nine degrees twenty eight minutes. Phenol's carbon oxygen bond is shorter, about one hundred thirty six picometres. And the ether angle opens to about one hundred eleven point seven degrees, with a carbon oxygen length near one hundred forty one picometres.
Then the acidity ladder. Strongest first, carboxylic acid, carbonic acid, phenol, water, alcohol, with p K a anchors around four to five, ten, fifteen point seven, and sixteen.

The alkene hydration summary, three routes in one line. Acid hydration, Markovnikov but may rearrange. Oxymercuration, Markovnikov with no rearrangement. And hydroboration oxidation, anti Markovnikov, syn, no rearrangement.

The four phenol routes, tagged by signature. Six twenty three kelvin and high pressure is Dow. Alkali fusion is from benzenesulphonic acid. Two seventy three to two seventy eight kelvin diazotisation is the diazonium route. And cumene gives phenol plus acetone.

The alcohol carbon oxygen orders, all of them the same carbocation stability order. Lucas and dehydration both run tertiary over secondary over primary. Oxidation gives aldehyde then acid from primary, a ketone from secondary, and nothing from tertiary. And iodoform needs the methyl carbon hydroxyl unit.

The ether cleavage triage, with hydrogen iodide the most reactive. Aryl ether gives phenol plus alkyl halide. A tertiary group goes S N one with the iodide on the tertiary carbon. Otherwise it is S N two, with the iodide on the smaller alkyl.
And the commercial equation, methanol from carbon monoxide and hydrogen. Carbon monoxide plus two hydrogen gives methanol.

Finally the commercial facts. Fermentation is invertase then zymase. Rectified is ninety five and a half percent, absolute is about one hundred percent, denatured is ethanol plus methanol, and power alcohol is the petrol blend. That is your complete toolkit for the chapter.

हम chapter के अंत तक पहुँच गए हैं, तो ये formula recap है। यहाँ rule सरल है। मैं पूरी toolkit को दोबारा बताऊँगा, फिर से नहीं पढ़ाऊँगा। हर item पर नज़र दौड़ाइए और जाँचिए कि वो पहले से दिमाग़ में पक्का है।
पहले, वो एक general formula। एक single oxygen वाला saturated compound C n H two n plus two O में fit होता है, और इसीलिए एक monohydric alcohol और उसका isomeric ether functional isomers हैं।

फिर geometry numbers। alcohol का carbon oxygen hydrogen angle one hundred nine degrees twenty eight minutes से ज़रा कम। phenol का carbon oxygen bond छोटा, लगभग one hundred thirty six picometres। और ether का angle खुलकर लगभग one hundred eleven point seven degrees, carbon oxygen length करीब one hundred forty one picometres।
फिर acidity ladder। सबसे मज़बूत पहले, carboxylic acid, carbonic acid, phenol, water, alcohol, p K a anchors करीब four to five, ten, fifteen point seven, और sixteen।

alkene hydration summary, एक line में तीन routes। acid hydration, Markovnikov पर rearrange हो सकता है। oxymercuration, Markovnikov बिना rearrangement। और hydroboration oxidation, anti Markovnikov, syn, बिना rearrangement।

चार phenol routes, signature से tagged। six twenty three kelvin और high pressure Dow है। alkali fusion benzenesulphonic acid से। two seventy three से two seventy eight kelvin diazotisation diazonium route है। और cumene phenol plus acetone देता है।

alcohol के carbon oxygen orders, सब वही carbocation stability order। Lucas और dehydration दोनों tertiary ऊपर secondary ऊपर primary चलते हैं। oxidation primary से aldehyde फिर acid, secondary से ketone, tertiary से कुछ नहीं देता। और iodoform को methyl carbon hydroxyl unit चाहिए।
ether cleavage triage, hydrogen iodide सबसे reactive। aryl ether phenol plus alkyl halide देता है। एक tertiary group S N one से iodide tertiary carbon पर। वरना S N two, iodide छोटे alkyl पर।
और commercial equation, carbon monoxide और hydrogen से methanol। carbon monoxide plus दो hydrogen methanol देता है।

आख़िर में commercial facts। fermentation invertase फिर zymase है। rectified पंचानबे दशमलव पाँच percent, absolute लगभग सौ percent, denatured ethanol plus methanol, और power alcohol petrol blend है। यही chapter की आपकी पूरी toolkit है।

board_events.text: Run your eye over this before the exam
Families: alcohol R-OH on sp3 C; phenol Ar-OH on ring; ether R-O-R' with no O-H. Alcohol and its ether isomer share C-n-H-2n+2-O.

Classify alcohols three ways (number of OH; 1/2/3-degree; allylic/benzylic/vinylic). Name via the longest chain through the OH carbon; keep the -e in diols; phenol and the benzenediols are retained names.
Alcohols from alkenes: acid = Markovnikov, may rearrange; oxymercuration = Markovnikov, no rearrangement; HBO = anti-Markovnikov, syn, no rearrangement.
Phenol, four routes: chlorobenzene/Dow (623 K, high P); benzenesulphonic acid (alkali fusion); diazonium hydrolysis (273-278 K); cumene (gives phenol plus acetone).
Acidity: carboxylic acid, carbonic acid, phenol, water, alcohol (strongest first); electron-withdrawing groups raise phenol acidity (picric acid), electron-releasing lower it (cresols).

Alcohol reactions: Lucas (SN1, 3/2/1-degree by turbidity speed); dehydration (E1, Saytzeff); oxidation (1 to aldehyde to acid, 2 to ketone, 3 resists); iodoform needs CH3CH(OH); ester loses the acid's OH.

Phenol ring (o/p): nitration (dilute gives o/p-nitrophenol, steam-separable; conc gives picric acid); bromine water gives 2,4,6-tribromophenol white ppt; Reimer-Tiemann gives salicylaldehyde; Kolbe gives salicylic acid; discriminators are NaHCO3, NaOH, Lucas, iodoform, neutral FeCl3 violet.
Ethers: Williamson (keep the halide primary); dehydration at 413 K (symmetrical only); cleavage by HX triage aryl/tertiary/otherwise. Boiling point near the alkane; water-solubility near the alcohol.

Commercial: methanol (wood spirit) is poison to formic acid to blindness; ethanol (grain) by fermentation (invertase, zymase); rectified 95.5, absolute 100, denatured (plus methanol), power (petrol blend).

segments.text: And finally, the chapter cheat sheet. This is not for learning, it is for the last minute before the exam. I will read the headlines and you check that each one is instantly familiar. If any line feels unfamiliar, that is where to revise.

The three families. Alcohol is oxygen hydrogen on an s p three carbon. Phenol is oxygen hydrogen on a ring. Ether is R minus O minus R prime with no oxygen hydrogen. And an alcohol and its ether isomer share the same molecular formula.

Classification and naming. Classify alcohols three ways, by number of oxygen hydrogens, by primary secondary tertiary, and by position. Name through the longest chain that contains the oxygen hydrogen carbon, keep the letter e in diols, and remember phenol and the benzenediols as retained names.

Alcohols from alkenes, the three route summary. Acid is Markovnikov and may rearrange. Oxymercuration is Markovnikov with no rearrangement. And hydroboration oxidation is anti Markovnikov, syn, no rearrangement.

Phenol, the four routes by signature. Chlorobenzene by Dow at six twenty three kelvin and high pressure. Benzenesulphonic acid by alkali fusion. Diazonium by hydrolysis at two seventy three to two seventy eight kelvin. And cumene, which gives phenol plus acetone.

Acidity, strongest first, carboxylic acid, carbonic acid, phenol, water, alcohol. Electron withdrawing groups raise phenol acidity, all the way to picric acid, and electron releasing groups lower it, as in the cresols.

Alcohol reactions in one breath. Lucas, S N one, sorted by turbidity speed. Dehydration, E one, Saytzeff. Oxidation, primary to aldehyde to acid, secondary to ketone, tertiary resists. Iodoform needs the methyl carbon hydroxyl unit. And in esterification, the acid loses its oxygen hydrogen, not the alcohol.

Phenol ring chemistry, all ortho para. Nitration, dilute gives ortho and para nitrophenol which steam separate, concentrated gives picric acid. Bromine water gives the white two four six tribromophenol. Reimer Tiemann gives salicylaldehyde, Kolbe gives salicylic acid. And the discriminators are bicarbonate, hydroxide, Lucas, iodoform, and neutral ferric chloride giving violet.

Ethers. Make them by Williamson, keeping the halide primary, or by dehydration at four hundred thirteen kelvin for symmetrical ones only. Cleave them by the halide triage, aryl then tertiary then otherwise. Their boiling point sits near the alkane, their water solubility near the alcohol.

<whisper>And the commercial alcohols to finish.</whisper> Methanol, the wood spirit, is poison, oxidised to formic acid, causing blindness. Ethanol, the grain alcohol, comes from fermentation by invertase then zymase. Rectified is ninety five point five, absolute is one hundred, denatured has methanol added, and power alcohol is the petrol blend. That is the whole of Alcohols, Phenols and Ethers, on one board. Well done.
और आख़िर में, chapter cheat sheet। ये सीखने के लिए नहीं, exam से ठीक पहले के लिए है। मैं headlines पढ़ूँगा और आप जाँचिए कि हर एक तुरंत जाना पहचाना है। अगर कोई line अनजानी लगे, वहीं revise कीजिए।

तीन families। alcohol एक s p three carbon पर oxygen hydrogen। phenol एक ring पर oxygen hydrogen। ether R minus O minus R prime बिना oxygen hydrogen। और एक alcohol तथा उसका ether isomer वही molecular formula साझा करते हैं।

classification और naming। alcohols को तीन तरह से classify कीजिए, oxygen hydrogens की संख्या से, primary secondary tertiary से, और position से। उस सबसे लंबी chain से नाम रखिए जिसमें oxygen hydrogen carbon हो, diols में e अक्षर रखिए, और phenol तथा benzenediols को retained names के रूप में याद रखिए।
alkenes से alcohols, तीन route summary। acid Markovnikov और rearrange हो सकता है। oxymercuration Markovnikov बिना rearrangement। और hydroboration oxidation anti Markovnikov, syn, बिना rearrangement।

phenol, signature से चार routes। chlorobenzene Dow से six twenty three kelvin और high pressure पर। benzenesulphonic acid alkali fusion से। diazonium hydrolysis से two seventy three से two seventy eight kelvin पर। और cumene, जो phenol plus acetone देता है।

acidity, सबसे मज़बूत पहले, carboxylic acid, carbonic acid, phenol, water, alcohol। electron withdrawing groups phenol की acidity बढ़ाते हैं, picric acid तक, और electron releasing groups घटाते हैं, जैसे cresols में।

alcohol reactions एक साँस में। Lucas, S N one, turbidity speed से छँटी। dehydration, E one, Saytzeff। oxidation, primary से aldehyde फिर acid, secondary से ketone, tertiary विरोध करता है। iodoform को methyl carbon hydroxyl unit चाहिए। और esterification में acid अपना oxygen hydrogen खोता है, alcohol नहीं।

phenol ring chemistry, सब ortho para। nitration, dilute ortho और para nitrophenol देता है जो steam से अलग होते हैं, concentrated picric acid देता है। bromine water सफ़ेद two four six tribromophenol देता है। Reimer Tiemann salicylaldehyde देता है, Kolbe salicylic acid देता है। और discriminators हैं bicarbonate, hydroxide, Lucas, iodoform, और neutral ferric chloride जो violet देता है।

Ethers। इन्हें Williamson से बनाइए, halide primary रखते हुए, या four hundred thirteen kelvin पर dehydration से सिर्फ़ symmetrical के लिए। इन्हें halide triage से तोड़िए, aryl फिर tertiary फिर otherwise। इनका boiling point alkane के पास बैठता है, water solubility alcohol के पास।

<whisper>और आख़िर में commercial alcohols।</whisper> methanol, wood spirit, ज़हर है, formic acid में oxidise होकर, अंधापन देता है। ethanol, grain alcohol, fermentation से आता है invertase फिर zymase से। rectified ninety five point five, absolute सौ, denatured में methanol मिला, और power alcohol petrol blend है। यही है पूरा Alcohols, Phenols and Ethers, एक board पर। शाबाश।
